conditions: Desktop OpenGL GLSL 4.60 core profile, as specified by the 2023-08-14 revision 4.60.8, with no SPIR-V generation or extension altering the relevant rule. The call resolves to a valid user-defined function with ordinary same-type scalar parameters and valid writable argument l-values wherever copy-out applies.
limitations: The rule does not order multiple copy-out operations, give a value for an unwritten out parameter, or prescribe the machine calling convention.

triggers: Issuer erratum, changed source representation, or contrary scoped evidence.

statement: An ordinary scalar GLSL function parameter qualified `in`, or declared without a direction qualifier, receives a copy at call time. An `out` parameter copies back only and an `inout` parameter copies both ways. Copy-out uses the argument l-value determined at call time.
